simple: Check Point’s line of next-generation firewalls for small and mid-sized businesses and branch offices (models from desktop to 1U, with Wi-Fi 7 and 5G). Every device has a firewall with user control, VPN between offices and for remote employees, QoS, protection for IoT devices (cameras, VoIP, printers) and SD-WAN for a backup link; management through a web interface, the cloud-based Spark Management for MSPs, or Smart-1. With the NGFW subscription: application control and an intrusion prevention system (IPS) — blocks attempts to exploit known vulnerabilities in traffic. The subscription works on any model in the line; in the first year the device ships with SNBT, after which you can renew NGFW, NGTP or SNBT.
